## Checklist
- [ ] Code compiles, `npm run lint` + `npm run test` pass locally
- [ ] Coding standards followed (ESLint/Prettier clean, no `any` unless justified)
- [ ] Layered architecture respected (controllers thin, services/repositories own logic)
- [ ] Request/response validation & sanitization updated where needed
- [ ] Database schema/migrations reviewed and applied (if data model touched)
- [ ] Documentation updated (`README.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, runbooks as needed)
- [ ] Security/privacy considerations addressed for this change
